parts.name: CalendarRoot
parts.description: A calendar for choosing one day: a `<div role="group">` that holds the value and the visible month and provides them to the other parts. Label it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, or put it in a FieldRoot. Inside a FieldRoot it is the field's control.

props.name: month
props.description: The first visible month, a `Temporal.PlainYearMonth`. Pass it with `onMonthChange` to control the page.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.default: the month of the value, else of today
props.description: The first visible month at first. Default: the month of the value, else of today.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called with the new first visible month when the previous or next button, a select or a key turns the page.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be focused or chosen. Days before it are disabled buttons, and the previous button stops at its month.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be focused or chosen. Days after it are disabled buttons, and the next button stops at its month.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days for which this returns true can be focused, and are announced as unavailable (`aria-disabled`, `data-unavailable`), but can't be chosen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every day and the navigation buttons natively. A day disabled while it has focus (`disabled={pending? saving}`) takes focus back when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Days stay focusable and the keyboard moves between them, but none can be chosen. Sets `aria-readonly` on the grids and `data-readonly`.

props.name: required
props.description: The hidden input is `required`: a day must be chosen for a form or a FieldRoot to be valid.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for month and day names, the days' accessible names, the first day of the week and the weekend. Default: the browser's.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The day the weeks start on, from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). Default: the locale's.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description: Always six rows of days, so the grid's height doesn't change from month to month.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: How many months are shown side by side, each in a CalendarGrid with its `offset`. The previous and next buttons, and the keyboard past the last month, turn this many at a time.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The time zone in which "today" is read. Default: the system's.

props.name: today
props.description: The day marked as today (`aria-current="date"`, `data-today`). Default: today in `timeZone`, read once.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: When it turns true (and on mount, if it starts true), moves focus to the chosen day, turning to its month, or with none to the grid's Tab stop. A date picker passes `autoFocus={open}`.

props.name: showWeekNumbers
props.description: CalendarGridHeader and CalendarGridBody add a first column of ISO week numbers.

props.name: weekNumberLabel
props.description: The week number column's name, and the start of each week number's accessible name: "Week" makes "Week 47".

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen day, a `Temporal.PlainDate`. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the calendar; `null` is a controlled calendar with nothing chosen. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The day chosen at first, when the calendar isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the day when the user chooses another one, and once when a form reset returns an uncontrolled calendar to its default. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves.

props.name: onSelectionComplete
props.description: Called on every press of a day that can be chosen, the day already chosen included. A date picker closes its popup here.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the chosen day under this name with a form, as an ISO date (`2026-11-17`), or an empty string. Without one, a named FieldRoot's name is used.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the value differs from its initial one.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the calendar is disabled, by its own prop or by its Field.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while a day is chosen.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while focus is in the calendar.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the calendar is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has been in the calendar and left it.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: RangeCalendarRoot
parts.description: A calendar for choosing a range of days. The first press sets the range's start; moving the pointer or focus previews it; a second press, before or after the first, completes it. Escape cancels a range under way. It takes the same parts as CalendarRoot.

props.name: month
props.description: The first visible month, a `Temporal.PlainYearMonth`. Pass it with `onMonthChange` to control the page.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.default: the month of the value, else of today
props.description: The first visible month at first. Default: the month of the range's start, else of today.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called with the new first visible month when the previous or next button, a select or a key turns the page.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be focused or chosen.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be focused or chosen.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days for which this returns true can be focused and are announced as unavailable, but can't start, end or (without `allowsNonContiguousRanges`) be inside a range.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every day and the navigation buttons natively.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Days stay focusable and the keyboard moves between them, but no range can be chosen.

props.name: required
props.description: The start's hidden input is `required`: a range must be chosen for a form or a FieldRoot to be valid.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for names, the first day of the week and the weekend. Default: the browser's.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The day the weeks start on, from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). Default: the locale's.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description: Always six rows of days.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: How many months are shown side by side; the previous and next buttons turn this many at a time.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The time zone in which "today" is read. Default: the system's.

props.name: today
props.description: The day marked as today. Default: today in `timeZone`, read once.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: When it turns true, drops a range left half-chosen and moves focus to the range's start, turning to its month, or with none to the grid's Tab stop. A date range picker passes `autoFocus={open}`.

props.name: showWeekNumbers
props.description: CalendarGridHeader and CalendarGridBody add a first column of ISO week numbers.

props.name: weekNumberLabel
props.description: The week number column's name, and the start of each week number's accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen range, `{ start, end }` with `start` never after `end`. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the calendar; `null` is a controlled calendar with nothing chosen.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The range chosen at first, when the calendar isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the range when its second day is pressed, and once when a form reset returns an uncontrolled calendar to its default. It is called in a change of its own.

props.name: onSelectionComplete
props.description: Called when a range is completed, even if it equals the range already chosen. A date range picker closes its popup here.

props.name: allowsNonContiguousRanges
props.default: false (a second press that would include one is ignored)
props.description: Lets a range include unavailable days. Without it, the preview stops at the range's first day and a second press that would include an unavailable day is ignored.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the range with a form as two entries, `<name>-start` and `<name>-end` (ISO dates, or empty strings). Without one, a named FieldRoot's name is used.

props.name: startName
props.description: The start date's name with a form, in place of `<name>-start`.

props.name: endName
props.description: The end date's name with a form, in place of `<name>-end`.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the value differs from its initial one.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the calendar is disabled, by its own prop or by its Field.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while a range is chosen.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while focus is in the calendar.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-pending
dataAttributes.description: Present while a range is under way.

dataAttributes.name: data-range
dataAttributes.description: Always present on a RangeCalendarRoot.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the calendar is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has been in the calendar and left it.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: CalendarMonthLabel
parts.description: The name of a visible month, "November 2026", as a polite live region, so turning the page announces the new month. Children replace the text.

props.name: offset
props.description: Which visible month, 0 for the first. Default: 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-month
dataAttributes.description: The month as an ISO string, `2026-11`.

parts.name: CalendarPreviousMonth
parts.description: A button that turns back a page (`numberOfMonths` months). Disabled when that page holds no day after `min`, or the calendar is disabled. Named "Previous month"; pass `aria-label` to translate it.

parts.name: CalendarNextMonth
parts.description: A button that turns forward a page (`numberOfMonths` months). Disabled when that page holds no day before `max`, or the calendar is disabled. Named "Next month"; pass `aria-label` to translate it.

parts.name: CalendarMonthSelect
parts.description: A native `<select>` of the months of the visible year, which sets the first visible month. A month with no day between `min` and `max` is a disabled option. Named "Month"; pass `aria-label` to translate it.

parts.name: CalendarYearSelect
parts.description: A native `<select>` of years, from `min`'s year to `max`'s (ten years either side where a limit is missing), which sets the first visible month's year. Named "Year"; pass `aria-label` to translate it.

parts.name: CalendarGrid
parts.description: A visible month: a `<table role="grid">` named by the month. It provides the month's weeks to the parts inside it (`use calendarGridState`). In a RangeCalendarRoot it is `aria-multiselectable`.

props.name: offset
props.description: Which visible month, 0 for the first. Default: 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the calendar is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-month
dataAttributes.description: The month as an ISO string, `2026-11`.

parts.name: CalendarGridHeader
parts.description: A `<thead>` with a row of weekday names (a CalendarGridHeaderCell each), in the locale's order, after a week-number header when the root has `showWeekNumbers`.

props.name: format
props.description: How the weekdays are written: "narrow" (M), "short" (Mon) or "long" (Monday). Each header is named with the long name either way. Default: "short".

dataAttributes.name: data-week-number
dataAttributes.description: On the week number column's header cell.

parts.name: CalendarGridHeaderCell
parts.description: A weekday's column header, `<th scope="col">`, named with the day's long name (`abbr` and `aria-label`). Children replace the name it shows.

props.name: weekday
props.description: The day, from the context's `weekdays`: `{ dayOfWeek, label, name }`.

dataAttributes.name: data-weekday
dataAttributes.description: The day of the week, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).

parts.name: CalendarGridBody
parts.description: A `<tbody>` with a row per week and, in each, a CalendarDayCell holding a CalendarDay per day, after a CalendarWeekNumber when the root has `showWeekNumbers`.

parts.name: CalendarWeekNumber
parts.description: A row header, `<th scope="row">`, showing the week's ISO number and named with the root's `weekNumberLabel` and the number ("Week 47"). Children replace the number.

props.name: week
props.description: The week, from the grid's `weeks`.

dataAttributes.name: data-week-number
dataAttributes.description: Always present.

parts.name: CalendarDayCell
parts.description: A day's grid cell, a `<td>` with `aria-selected` (for a day of the grid's month). It provides the day's state to the CalendarDay inside it, and to a custom part (`use calendarCell`).

props.name: day
props.description: The day, from a week's `days`.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day can't be focused: before `min`, after `max`, outside the month, or the calendar is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-outside-month
dataAttributes.description: Present on a day of the previous or next month that fills the first or last row. It is shown, but disabled and hidden from assistive technology.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-end
dataAttributes.description: Present on the last day of the range, or of the preview.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-middle
dataAttributes.description: Present on the days between the range's first and last.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-preview
dataAttributes.description: Present on the days of a range under way, before its second day is pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-start
dataAttributes.description: Present on the first day of the range, or of the preview.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day is chosen, or inside the range (or the preview of one).

dataAttributes.name: data-today
dataAttributes.description: Present on today.

dataAttributes.name: data-unavailable
dataAttributes.description: Present when `isDateUnavailable` returns true for the day.

dataAttributes.name: data-weekend
dataAttributes.description: Present on the locale's weekend days.

parts.name: CalendarDay
parts.description: A day's `<button>`: a press, Enter or Space chooses it, and the arrow keys, Home, End, PageUp and PageDown move focus. Only one day of the calendar is in the Tab order. Named with the full date ("Tuesday, November 17, 2026"); today has `aria-current="date"`; an unavailable day `aria-disabled="true"`. Shows the day of the month in the locale's digits, unless given children.

dataAttributes.name: data-date
dataAttributes.description: The day as an ISO string, `2026-11-17`.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the button is disabled: before `min`, after `max`, outside the month, or the calendar is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-outside-month
dataAttributes.description: Present on a day of the previous or next month that fills a row: disabled and `aria-hidden`.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-end
dataAttributes.description: Present on the last day of the range, or of the preview.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-middle
dataAttributes.description: Present on the days between the range's first and last.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-preview
dataAttributes.description: Present on the days of a range under way.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-start
dataAttributes.description: Present on the first day of the range, or of the preview.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day is chosen, or inside the range (or the preview of one).

dataAttributes.name: data-today
dataAttributes.description: Present on today.

dataAttributes.name: data-unavailable
dataAttributes.description: Present when `isDateUnavailable` returns true for the day.

dataAttributes.name: data-weekend
dataAttributes.description: Present on the locale's weekend days.
